description: This file defines core messaging classes and templates for a C++ project, including a base category type template, a text message class, and a macro for defining messaging categories. It also includes licensing information and external dependencies.

classes.name: BaseCategoryType
classes.description: A template class representing a category type with associated text data, supporting formatting and data retrieval.

classes.name: TextMessage
classes.description: A class implementing a text message, supporting serialization and deserialization, inheriting from Core::Messaging::IEvent.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TextMessage into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the TextMessage from a buffer.
